title: Time-MAGNET: Federated Multimodal Graph Neural Expert Transformer for Human Activity Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2508.01701v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Human Activity Recognition plays a vital role in applications such as fitness tracking, smart homes, and healthcare monitoring. Single modality HAR systems rely on a single source of sensory information and can therefore be affected by sensor specific noise and signal degradation, which may limit their ability to distinguish between activities. To address these limitations, this work proposes Time-MAGNET, a novel multimodal learning framework that adaptively fuses heterogeneous sensing modalities to learn discriminative representations for HAR. It adaptively models interactions among heterogeneous modalities using graph attention and a Mixture-of-Experts architecture. To capture complex temporal dependencies, we employ a lightweight encoder-only T5 architecture customized for multimodal HAR and efficiently trained using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA). translated_abstract: 人体活动识别（HAR）在健身追踪、智能家居和医疗健康监测等应用中发挥着至关重要的作用。单模态HAR系统依赖单一来源的传感信息，因此可能受到特定传感器噪声和信号退化的影响，从而限制其区分不同活动的能力。为了解决这些局限性，本工作提出了Time-MAGNET，这是一种新颖的多模态学习框架，能够自适应地融合异构感知模态，为HAR学习具有判别性的表示。该框架利用图注意力和专家混合架构自适应地建模异构模态之间的交互。为了捕获复杂的时序依赖关系，我们采用了专为多模态HAR定制的轻量级编码器式T5架构，并借助低秩自适应（LoRA）技术进行高效训练。在现实世界的应用中，多模态HAR数据通常分布式地……（摘要在此处不完整）
tldr: 该论文提出Time-MAGNET，一种结合图注意力、专家混合架构与LoRA高效微调的联邦多模态学习框架，通过自适应融合异构传感模态来提升人体活动识别的判别能力和鲁棒性。
